about: Labelled questions for refusal.mjs. in_scope: a crew member could ask it and one note answers it (note is that note's id); several are paraphrases that share few words with the note. out_of_scope: no note answers it; several share words with a note on purpose. Write your own set when you replace the notes.

in_scope.q: How do I take a water sample from the stream?
Which way should I face when I fill a bottle?
What should I write on the bottle label?
Can I use a nickname for the site on the label?
How many hours do samples have to reach the lab?
What do I pack before heading out?
Who should I tell where I am going?
The pH number keeps creeping up. What now?
How long do I hold the probe in the water?
Is it safe to wade in when the creek is deep and fast?
What if there is a thunderstorm?

out_of_scope.q: Who won the football game last night?
What is the capital of France?
How do I fix a flat bike tyre?
What time does the lab open at the weekend?
Can you recommend a good water bottle to buy?
What is the weather forecast for tomorrow?
Which phone has the best camera?
How do I calibrate a microscope?
Is stream water safe to drink?
